target_customer: Real estate agents, e-commerce brands, tourism and drone inspection teams wanting 3D scenes from photos and video
problem: Producing photorealistic 3D scenes normally needs special equipment and slow processing. DigitalCarbon turns ordinary photos and videos into interactive 3D that renders at high frame rates on everyday devices.
business_model: App and developer API (pricing not stated)
product_category: Gaussian splatting and radiance field 3D capture

founders.name: Guru Rao
founders.background_notes: First hire and AI Lead at AssemblyAI, which he helped scale from 1 to 100+ employees (YC page).

founders.name: Michael Nguyen
founders.background_notes: YC description says the founders were the first and second hires at AssemblyAI.

technical_complexity.rationale: Radiance field reconstruction with fast rendering on consumer devices is research heavy, and the company describes itself as a research lab exploring diffusion models for sparse inputs.

defensibility.rationale: Open research in splatting spreads quickly and larger players ship similar features; no proprietary data is documented.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Unverified: later press says Zillow and Apartments.com added splat tours in 2025; nothing shows an acquisition of DigitalCarbon.

market_need_then: Interest in virtual tours and 3D product views existed, but no dated demand evidence for the Summer 2024 period was found; the launch post sought beta testers.

identity.voice_and_tone: Upbeat and promotional; playful touches such as a 'Fun!' option in signup.

brand_strength.rationale: Little public brand evidence; the name leans toward carbon and climate tools, which brings search confusion with carbon management companies.

outcome_analysis: DigitalCarbon is a Summer 2024 company founded by early AssemblyAI employees, still listed as active with early access signups. Radiance Fields coverage from 2024 treats it as a research lab. No verified funding, revenue or exit exists in public sources, so success or failure is undetermined.
notes: Unverified: aggregators report $500K from YC and angels in Sep or Oct 2024 (labelled seed or pre-seed); no primary source so no round recorded. Radiance Fields page has a conflicting date (byline Oct 2, 2024 vs metadata). Competitor list left empty: dated sources near the batch name no competitors, and 2026 vendor blogs are not as of founding. The Takeover note about Zillow comes from a vendor blog. No outcome news found. Completeness pass: round recorded from Startupintros seed (single database; VCBacked labels it pre-seed, dates differ between Sep and Oct 2024).
